10118|c6fbc16f.name: Nessa Shadowsong
10118|c6fbc16f.text: The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

12656|307aaccf.name: Thamarian
12656|307aaccf.text:
On the northern dock, you can board a ship that will carry you to Rut'theran Village and Darnassus. From the southern dock, you can find passage across the Great Sea to Menethil Harbor on Khaz Modan, and onwards to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you head to the western dock, you can board a ship setting sail for Stormwind.

Safe journeys to you!

12716|2ba45c06.name: Decedra Willham
12716|2ba45c06.text: I do so enjoy sitting out here, listening to the sounds of the Great Sea.  Oh, what?  Yes, there is a ship that will take you to Menethil Harbor.  It docks here from time to time.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|2237a3b1.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

277024|6f25fb7c.name: Jelinek Sharpshear
277024|6f25fb7c.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink $r tattoos, anything you might need!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4895|8ee6c481.name: Smiling Jim
4895|8ee6c481.text:
He'll bring you mead
He'll bring you beer
A grinning face from ear to ear
He's served us all from year to year
We call him Smiling Jim.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5499|8e3035a9.name: Lilyssia Nightbreeze
5499|8e3035a9.text: My teachings would be too advanced for you at this stage. If you wish to learn more of potions, speak with Tel'Athir here instead.

5500|52c0a909.name: Tel'Athir
5500|52c0a909.text: I am honored to share my knowledge with you, $N. See that you use it well.

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

9559|c670fd35.name: Grizzlowe
9559|c670fd35.text: I must say, Booty Bay has the best Clam Chowder to be had anywhere in the South Seas. Oh, not interested in cuisine eh? Well then let me be the first to welcome you to the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, the finest passenger ship to travel between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. She's due back for another trip to Ratchet in the Barrens soon, so make yourself comfortable till she arrives.

284-complete.name: Unknown
284-complete.text:
This barrel is largely untouched.  Prying it open...

...you are assaulted by the pungent odor of cheese.  It's a little wet, but still tasty!
284-complete.title: The Search Continues

285-accept.name: Unknown
285-accept.text:
This grouping of Murloc hovels, after a thorough inspection, reveals nothing.

...but you're certain that the next clue you find will be fruitful.

One of the hovels to the north must have the Menethil Statuette!
285-accept.title: Search More Hovels

285-complete.name: Unknown
285-complete.text: This barrel is halfway buried amidst the mud and grass ...
285-complete.title: Search More Hovels

286-accept.name: Unknown
286-accept.text:
After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw.  It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with hammer upraised.

This must be the Menethil Statuette!  You must now return it to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
286-accept.title: Return the Statuette

286-complete.name: Karl Boran
286-complete.text:
The captain of the Blind Princess will be relieved to hear this precious cargo has been recovered.  You have well earned this payment for services rendered.

It is good to see dependable folk like you, especially in trying times such as these.
286-complete.title: Return the Statuette

289-complete.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-complete.text: My thanks to you, $N. And the gratitude of my cursed brethren goes to you as well.
289-complete.title: The Cursed Crew

289-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-progress.text: In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! Please, good sir, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.
289-progress.title: The Cursed Crew

290-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
290-accept.text:
To break the curse and free all of my brethren, the...thing...stowed on my ship must be retrieved and cleansed! I don't know what it was, but I do know that it was stored securely in the ship's strongbox, which Captain Halyndor lorded over.

My old captain is still in my dreams. I know he walks my doomed ship, the Intrepid. Get the key from him, and use it to open the Intrepid's strongbox.

Then, after you have the cursed thing, bring it to the priest Glorin Steelbrow in town.
290-accept.title: Lifting the Curse

306-complete.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-complete.text: Such horrible news! At least 3 of them survived. But when will the killing end? I long for the day when King Magni's subjects can live without fear.
306-complete.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-progress.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-progress.text: Were you able to find Merrin? Did she send word?
306-progress.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

471-complete.name: James Halloran
471-complete.text:
Hmm... Don't suppose you'd be interested in becoming my apprentice, would you?

Hah! No, I'm just kidding. You're much too old, for one thing. Besides - from the looks of you, it would seem that you have other ambitions in life. Nonetheless, these are some fine skins you've procured, and I'll be able to put them to good use.
471-complete.title: Apprentice's Duties

471-progress.name: James Halloran
471-progress.text:
My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.

Ah, $N, how goes it?  Do you have my skins?
471-progress.title: Apprentice's Duties

6343-complete.name: Nessa Shadowsong
6343-complete.text:
This is very interesting.  The fish here are large, but I didn't think the difference in bounties between here and the mainland was so great.  There must be a reason for this...

Well thank you, $N.  I will discuss with the villagers the news you brought.  Perhaps, one day, we will find the root of this oddity.  But until then, we shall reap its benefits!
6343-complete.title: Return to Nessa

6343-progress.name: Nessa Shadowsong
6343-progress.text: $N, you're back from Auberdine?  Did you speak with Laird?
6343-progress.title: Return to Nessa

79008-accept.name: Unknown
79008-accept.text:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008-accept.title: ... and that note you found

79008-complete.name: Unknown
79008-complete.text: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
79008-complete.title: ... and that note you found

79192-accept.name: Unknown
79192-accept.text: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192-accept.title: Stepping Stones

98072-accept.name: James Halloran
98072-accept.text:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!
98072-accept.title: Crocs of the Sky

98189-accept.name: Karl Boran
98189-accept.text:
My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!

The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!

I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?
98189-accept.title: Return the Statuette

98189-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98189-complete.text: You managed to get it back from those monsters! There aren't too many artifacts of the late king left now.
98189-complete.title: Return the Statuette

98189-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98189-progress.text: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.
98189-progress.title: Return the Statuette

98190-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
98190-accept.text:
You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, lad. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
98190-accept.title: A Friend of the Family

98190-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-complete.text: You have my gratitude for recovering this. I am relieved it did not fall into the wrong hands.
98190-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98190-progress.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-progress.text: Let us speak, $c. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-accept.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98191-accept.text:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
98191-accept.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-complete.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-complete.text:
By the Light... it looks just like his boy...

<Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.>

This statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength.

It is best kept here for now, under guard of the paladin order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead.

Thank you, $c. Light bless you.
98191-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-progress.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-progress.text: Light be with you, $c. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98219-accept.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98219-accept.text:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, $N.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98219-accept.title: The Shamed Lieutenant
